subject: general
question: Who founded the Satyashodhak Samaj (Truth - Seeking Society)?
solution:
The Correct Answer is **__Jyotirao Phule.__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Satyashodhak Samaj **was a social reform society that was founded by **Jyotiba Phule** in Pune, Maharashtra.
 
• Satyashodhak Samaj was founded on **24 September 1873.**
 
• Mahatma Jyotiba Phule was an Indian social activist, thinker, anti-caste social reformer and writer who belongs to **Maharashtra.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bharatvarshiya Brahmo Samaj Society **was founded by **Keshab Chandra Sen **in the year **1866**.
 
• Ram Mohan Roy formed the **Brahmo Samaj (Society of Brahma) **in the year 1828.
 
• Devendra Nath founded **Shantiniketan (“Abode of Peace”)**, in the year 1863.
